title: CoPiT: A conditional Position-induced Transformer for aerodynamic field prediction on unstructured meshes
abstract: arXiv:2610.32299v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-fidelity Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) simulations remain a standard tool for aerodynamic analysis, yet each solve on an unstructured mesh is computationally expensive, making many-query tasks such as design exploration, optimization, and multi-condition evaluation costly. Neural operators provide mesh-flexible surrogates for mapping geometry and operating conditions to flow fields; however, in many existing architectures, global parameters such as the freestream state and design variables are concatenated with pointwise inputs, leaving their influence on intermediate features implicit. translated_title: CoPiT：一种用于非结构网格气动场预测的条件位置诱导Transformer
translated_abstract: 高保真雷诺平均Navier-Stokes（RANS）模拟仍然是气动分析的标准工具，然而每次在非结构网格上进行求解的计算成本都很高，使得设计探索、优化和多工况评估等多查询任务代价高昂。神经算子为将几何外形和运行条件映射到流场提供了对网格灵活的代理模型；然而，在许多现有架构中，诸如自由流状态和设计变量等全局参数只是与逐点输入拼接在一起，导致它们对中间特征的影响是隐式的。本文提出了CoPiT，一种条件位置诱导Transformer（Conditional Position-induced Transformer），它以位置诱导Transformer（PiT）作为几何骨干，并通过多阶段特征级线性调制（FiLM）注入全局条件向量，从而使参数化调制显式化，同时保持几何……（原文摘要不完整，此处为现有内容之翻译）
tldr: 本文提出CoPiT模型，以PiT为几何骨干并通过多阶段FiLM调制显式注入全局条件向量，实现了非结构网格上高效准确的气动场预测。
en_tdlr: CoPiT injects global condition vectors into a PiT geometric backbone via multi-stage FiLM modulation, enabling explicit parametric conditioning for efficient aerodynamic field prediction on unstructured meshes.
